entry.title: dotnet/efcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-25
entry.content:
Issues

Closed

  • Cosmos: Expand checks against null values for nested properties to first check parents for null #17746
  • RowVersion concurrency issue when replacing entities with inheritance and owned types #37588
  • EF Core 10: .HasDiscriminator("Discriminator") fails when using default discriminator name (works if renamed) #37571
    11.0.0
  • Update json schema for property name changes in complex property during migration #37792
  • Regression in EF10: IsRequired() Complex Property is null when accessed from Parent.Children[x].ComplexProperty and its fields are null #37800

Updated

  • Improve GroupBy translation for JSON-owned properties to avoid N scalar subqueries #37778
    Backlog
  • Enable IIdentityResolutionInterceptor for queries #37574
    Backlog
  • Scaffold-DbContext flag to force update (without deleting other entities) #37796
  • JOIN instead of CROSS APPLY in generated query in SQL Server #17936
    Backlog
  • Allow FKs to exist in the model but avoid creating them in the database #15854
    Backlog
  • In-Memory Corruption of Nested Owned Entities After SaveChanges with Record 'with' Expression #37581
    11.0.0
  • Add MSBuild tests for EFCore.Tasks and dotnet-ef #33136
    MQ
  • Add CosmosClientTelemetryOptions.DisableDistributedTracing #37615
    Backlog
  • Support "unconstrained" foreign key relationships #13146
    Backlog

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/10.0] Fix invalid SQL parameter names for switch/case pattern-matched variables #37805
  • Implement SQLite TimeSpan translation #37804
    community-contribution
  • Fix NRE in setter for nullable complex properties on shared TPH columns #37803
  • Cascade un-delete to owned dependents when re-parenting entity between parents #37802
  • Fix FK dependency ordering when replacing row-sharing owned entity #37799
  • Fix FK dependency ordering when replacing inline owned entity with FK to separate entity #37798

Merged

  • Fix RowVersion concurrency issue when replacing entities with TPH inheritance and owned types #37788
  • Fix HasDiscriminator with default name "Discriminator" failing for non-string types #37785
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/10.0' => 'main' #37790
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37801
  • [release/10.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #37793

Updated

  • Add skills #37768
  • [release/10.0] Fix InvalidCastException in OriginalValues.ToObject() with nested nullable complex properties #37703
    Servicing-consider
  • [release/10.0] Fix ExecuteUpdate over scalar projections #37791
  • Fix in-memory corruption of nested owned entities after SaveChanges when navigation is replaced #37787
  • [release/10.0] Fix owned entities with default values not saved in TPH with shared columns #37751
  • Fix owned entity data loss when moving between parent collections #37693
